title: WeatherCore: Important Systems
summary: Read the WeatherCore signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Weather profiles, radios, storm scanners, exposure notes, and hazard forecasts describe whether the problem is immediate, building, or regional.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch forecast direction, storm profile, exposure, route distance, shelter access, radio or scanner output, and whether weather stacks with local hazards.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A WeatherCore system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
